text: A day on Venus is longer than its year — it takes 243 Earth days to rotate once but only 225 days to orbit the Sun.
Bananas are slightly radioactive because they contain potassium-40, a naturally occurring radioactive isotope.
Your brain uses about 20% of your body's total energy, despite making up only 2% of your weight.
Oxford University is older than the Aztec Empire — Oxford was teaching by 1096, while the Aztec capital was founded in 1325.
The first computer mouse, built in 1964 by Doug Engelbart, was made of wood.
Octopuses have three hearts: two pump blood through the gills, and one circulates it to the rest of the body.
The world's first paper money was used in China during the Tang Dynasty over 1,400 years ago.
The term 'artificial intelligence' was coined in 1956 at the Dartmouth Conference by John McCarthy.
Russia spans 11 time zones — more than any other country on Earth.
Your stomach gets a new lining every 3-4 days because stomach acid would otherwise digest it.
